How are you feeling about it?\\nseeker: I'm feeling pretty down, actually. It's made me question my abilities and what I'm really contributing at work.\\nsupporter: It's understandable to feel that way. You've been handling a lot, and criticism can feel overwhelming. It feels like everything's been piling up, and I'm struggling to keep up with expectations.\\nsupporter: It's hard when everything seems like it's accumulating. You've had a lot on your plate, especially since the conflict with a coworker and the added pressures. Do you think the feedback was fair, or does it feel more like an overwhelming time for you?\\nseeker: Honestly, part of it might be fair, but I also can't help feeling like I'm being judged more harshly because of past incidents, like that project last year with the errors.\\nsupporter: I remember you talking about how challenging that was. It sounds like some of the stress from then might still be lingering. Have you talked to anyone about how you're feeling, perhaps your therapist?\\nseeker: Yeah, I've been trying to keep up with therapy. It's helpful, but days like today make it hard to remember the positives.\\nsupporter: I'm glad you're staying connected with therapy. Remember, you're making progress, even if it doesn't feel like it right now. What small things can you do today to take care of yourself?\\nseeker: Maybe I'll go for a walk or do something creative. I haven't drawn in a while, and that used to help me relax.\\nsupporter: That sounds like a wonderful idea. Taking time for yourself is important, especially when you're dealing with so much stress. How about some light exercises like yoga? I remember you mentioning it helped in the past.\\nseeker: Yeah, yoga could be good. I should get back to it. Thanks for reminding me.\\nsupporter: Anytime, Charlotte. You've worked hard and deserve to be gentle with yourself right now. Is there anything else on your mind that you'd like to talk about?\\nseeker: Just trying not to let this affect my job too much. I still enjoy some parts of it, like those moments when I really connect with a project.\\nsupporter: That's a great mindset. Focusing on the parts you enjoy can be very grounding. You've had recognition for projects before, like the one you were acknowledged on recently. It shows your capability.\\nseeker: Thanks for reminding me of that. It helps to remember those moments, especially now.\\nsupporter: I'm glad to be here for you. Don't hesitate to reach out whenever you need someone to talk to.\\nseeker: I will. I appreciate your support.
